name: Shuumatsu Kankin
source:
The end times draw near. The world is coming to an end...
You have nothing to lose and as such... you abduct two girls, and have your way with them.
This is the last month you spend... and you spend it drowning in debauchery.

After all, who wants to die a virgin!?

Will will become of you, and the two girls you have abducted.
One, fighting and resisting, hates your guts and still wants to live a normal life!
The other submissive in resignation, understanding that the end is near and at peace with herself.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ057749.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
末日将近，世界即将毁灭……
你已经一无所有，于是……你绑架了两名女性，任意凌辱她们。
这是生命最后的一个月……你选择沉溺在无尽放纵之中。

毕竟，谁愿意以处子之身死去！？

你与两名被绑架的女性最终会迎来怎样的结局？
一人仍在拼命反抗，恨你入骨，渴望回归正常生活！
另一人则认命顺从，明白末日将至，内心已恢复平静。
